PREPLANNING_CONTEXT: {"version":1,"schema_version":2,"epicId":"7f42-e41f-a501-4007","generatedAt":"2026-06-02T00:00:00Z","generatedBy":"preplanning","epic":{"title":"Test creation calibration (b): suite growth tracks behavioral coverage, not line count","description":"Intent-coverage contract + manifest-claim breadth + header-source check, consumed by pre-commit/verifier/CI, with multi-language e2e and per-language dynamic-import fail-open.","successCriteria":["sc-1","sc-2","sc-3","sc-4","sc-5","sc-6"]},"researchFindings":[],"stories":[{"id":"bca2-b2e4-92a2-4b99","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want a published findings contract and a manifest-claim breadth check, so that an end-state intent with no registered test is surfaced with a schema-validated finding.","description":"## Description
**What**: Publish plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-coverage-findings.md with an embedded jsonschema (contract_version=1) defining the seven finding types and their severities, and implement plugins/dso/scripts/intent-coverage-check.sh implementing the (a) manifest-claim breadth check.
**Why**: This is the walking skeleton for the epic: it establishes the finding-record shape every consumer validates against, and the first check that produces the headline signal 'intent with no test'.
**Scope**:
- IN: intent-coverage-findings.md contract doc; the jsonschema artifact; the seven finding types (intent_with_no_test, test_artifact_missing_on_disk, test_artifact_fails, header_source_mismatch, dynamic_import_inconclusive, source_files_unresolved, file_impact_likely_stale) with severities; contract_version=1; intent-coverage-check.sh reading the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh; per end-state intent_id steps (i) entry presence, (ii) realpath normalization then on-disk existence, (iii) test pass/fail; pre-commit-mode flag that runs only steps (i)+(ii); --output-file flag for ARG_MAX-safe findings output; exit codes 0/1/2.
- OUT: the header-vs-source check (sc-3); the consumers (sc-4); the e2e fixture suite (sc-5); per-language dynamic-import detection (sc-6).","priority":0,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":true,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-coverage-findings.md is published and its embedded jsonschema validates against the JSON Schema draft-07 meta-schema ← Satisfies: sc-1","The schema enumerates all seven finding types and carries contract_version=1; a findings document emitted by intent-coverage-check.sh validates against the schema ← Satisfies: sc-1","intent-coverage-check.sh reads the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh and, for an end-state intent_id whose test_artifact path is absent on disk, emits test_artifact_missing_on_disk; for an intent_id with no manifest entry it emits intent_with_no_test ← Satisfies: sc-2","intent-coverage-check.sh in pre-commit mode runs only entry-presence and on-disk-existence checks (no test execution), writes findings via --output-file, and returns exit code 0 with no findings / 1 with warn-only findings / 2 with a block-mode finding ← Satisfies: sc-2","When this story is complete, intent-coverage-check.sh in full (non-pre-commit) mode runs step (iii) test execution and, for an end-state intent_id whose registered test_artifact exists on disk but fails when run, emits the test_artifact_fails finding (block-mode) and returns exit code 2; the finding is suppressed when the manifest entry sets deferred_test:true ← Satisfies: sc-2","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-2"],"considerations":["[Dependency] External blocker 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 (manifest schema): intent-coverage-check.sh reads the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh; cross-epic dependency, not an in-epic story dependency.","[Dependency] External blocker a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 (Closure Checks schema cleavage): findings reference end-state SC/DoD/AC items separated from Closure Checks by a03c's schema.","[Build] intent-coverage-check.sh is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.","[Reliability] test_artifact.path resolution normalizes via realpath before the on-disk existence test to avoid symlink false negatives."],"scopeSplitCandidate":true,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":[],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-1;sc-2"},{"id":"e2e0-90c3-887b-4708","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want a header-vs-source import check, so that a test claiming an intent but referencing none of the intent's source files is surfaced as a mismatch.","description":"## Description
**What**: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/intent-header-source-check.sh implementing the (a+) header-vs-source import check.
**Why**: Catches tests that claim an intent in their header but do not reference the intent's source files — a tautology-prone but cheap second signal that complements manifest-claim breadth.
**Scope**:
- IN: applies only to test files carrying an intent-claim header per d566 Rule 6 (header-less files skipped); per file: extract intent_id; resolve source_files via the manifest entry's source_files field, else the parent ticket's file_impact array, else emit source_files_unresolved (warn, fail-open, skip the check for that intent); when file_impact is used, additionally check disk presence and emit file_impact_likely_stale (warn) for missing entries while still matching against surviving entries; parse the test file with sg (ast-grep); emit header_source_mismatch when the test references no source_files entry; --output-file ARG_MAX-safe findings output; validate emitted findings against the sc-1 schema.
- OUT: per-language dynamic-import fail-open detection (sc-6); manifest-claim breadth check (sc-2); multi-surface wiring (sc-4); e2e fixtures (sc-5).","priority":1,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["intent-header-source-check.sh skips test files without an intent-claim header and, for a headered test file whose content references no source_files entry, emits header_source_mismatch validating against the sc-1 schema ← Satisfies: sc-3","When an intent has no manifest source_files field and an empty parent file_impact, the script emits source_files_unresolved (warn) and skips the (a+) check for that intent ← Satisfies: sc-3","When source_files are resolved from file_impact and a referenced path is absent on disk, the script emits file_impact_likely_stale (warn) and still matches against the surviving file_impact entries ← Satisfies: sc-3","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-3"],"considerations":["[Dependency] External blocker d566-afa6-1aa3-4293 (Rule 6 intent-claim header): the script parses the header format d566 defines; cross-epic dependency.","[Dependency] External blocker 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6: source_files resolution prefers the manifest entry's source_files field.","[Build] intent-header-source-check.sh is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.","[Reliability] When sg is absent or has no parser for the test language the script emits dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn, fail-open) and runs no grep fallback, because grep fallback produces false positives."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["bca2-b2e4-92a2-4b99"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-3"},{"id":"fa72-1ea7-755c-401a","title":"As a sprint orchestrator, I want the findings consumed across pre-commit, the 94ed validator, and CI, so that coverage gaps surface at the right surface with the right severity.","description":"## Description
**What**: Wire the published contract into its three consumers: (a) plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-intent-coverage-gate.sh, (b) 94ed-f55c's manifest-aware default validator finding-type mapping, (c) .github/workflows/intent-coverage.yml.
**Why**: A finding that no surface consumes is invisible; this story delivers the multi-surface consumption that makes closure non-silent and gives CI a per-PR signal.
**Scope**:
- IN: pre-commit-intent-coverage-gate.sh invoking only the FAST checks (file existence plus header parse) with no test-runner invocation, block-mode reserved for intent_with_no_test at closure-time detected via the ticket-transition hook; the 94ed validator ingesting findings JSON and registering all seven finding types for rendering in the completion-verifier 'Intent Allocation Findings' section; intent-coverage.yml invoking both scripts plus the step-iii test-pass validation at CI time, posting findings via upsert-by-marker on the stable marker COVERAGE_FINDINGS_<epic-id>, with a GHA-job-summary fallback when comment-write is unavailable.
- OUT: the scripts themselves (sc-2, sc-3); the e2e fixture suite (sc-5); per-language dynamic-import detection (sc-6).","priority":2,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["pre-commit-intent-coverage-gate.sh invokes only file-existence and header-parse checks (no test runner) and does not block on warn-only findings ← Satisfies: sc-4","pre-commit-intent-coverage-gate.sh validates the findings JSON it ingests against the sc-1 jsonschema before processing and skips malformed findings ← Satisfies: sc-1","The 94ed manifest-aware validator ingests the findings JSON, validates it against the sc-1 schema, and registers all seven finding types for rendering; a closure with an unregistered SC produces a non-empty 'Intent Allocation Findings' section naming the SC ← Validates Closure Check: "(i) MID_SPRINT_SC_ADDITION: fixture epic with 1 SC and 1 test_artifact registered passing; a 2nd SC is added to the epic description without registering a corresponding test_artifact. intent-coverage-check.sh surfaces intent_with_no_test for the new SC; completion-verifier dispatch produces non-empty 'Intent Allocation Findings' section. Verifies the primary real-world miss pattern."","intent-coverage.yml validates the findings JSON produced by both scripts against the sc-1 jsonschema before posting the PR comment or GHA summary, rejecting malformed findings ← Satisfies: sc-1","The closure-time block-check reads the manifest deferred_test field and does not block closure for an intent whose entry sets deferred_test:true ← Satisfies: sc-4","intent-coverage.yml invokes both scripts plus the step-iii test-pass validation and upserts a single PR comment by the COVERAGE_FINDINGS_<epic-id> marker, editing in place on re-run rather than threading ← Satisfies: sc-4","When comment-write is unavailable the workflow writes the findings to the GHA job summary so the marker and findings are not dropped ← Satisfies: sc-4","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-4"],"considerations":["[Dependency] External blocker a03c-d55e-1393-4f27: the 94ed validator is registered with a03c's pluggable end-state-item-validator hook.","[Dependency] External blocker 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6: consumer (b) hooks into 94ed's manifest-aware default validator.","[Build] pre-commit-intent-coverage-gate.sh is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.","[Deployment] On fork PRs with a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN the comment upsert fails; the GHA-summary fallback is the interim signal pending fork-PR security work.","[Scope/Ownership] This story owns the closure-time intent_with_no_test block-check wiring (via the ticket-transition hook) plus its deferred_test:true suppression (epic State Lifecycle: SC4(a) pre-commit gate plus closure-time block-check is the CONSUME owner of deferred_test). draft-4 scenario (f) only exercises suppression as a fixture; the consuming logic is built here."],"scopeSplitCandidate":true,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["bca2-b2e4-92a2-4b99","e2e0-90c3-887b-4708"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-1;sc-4"},{"id":"24f0-8cf6-ec68-417f","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want per-language dynamic-import fail-open verification, so that tests using dynamic imports are warned rather than wrongly marked as mismatches.","description":"## Description
**What**: Verify the per-language dynamic-import fail-open behavior of intent-header-source-check.sh for Python, JavaScript, and Ruby.
**Why**: Dynamic imports defeat static source-symbol matching; treating them as header_source_mismatch would produce false positives that erode trust in the signal. Fail-open with a warn keeps the check honest.
**Scope**:
- IN: detection and dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn) emission for Python importlib.import_module with a variable arg, JavaScript eval/Function/dynamic require with a computed string, and Ruby send/public_send; assertions that pre-commit does not block and the verifier surfaces these as informational (non-blocking) findings.
- OUT: the header-source check core logic (sc-3, draft-2); the broader nine-scenario e2e suite (sc-5, draft-4).","priority":3,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["For a Python test using importlib.import_module with a variable arg, a JavaScript test using eval/Function/dynamic require with a computed string, and a Ruby test using send/public_send, the check emits dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn) for each rather than header_source_mismatch ← Satisfies: sc-6","On a test file emitting dynamic_import_inconclusive the pre-commit gate does not block and the completion-verifier renders the finding as informational (non-blocking) ← Satisfies: sc-6","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-6"],"considerations":["[Reliability] Detection uses sg ast-grep patterns per language; when no parser exists for a language the same dynamic_import_inconclusive fail-open path applies with no grep fallback.","[Dependency] Builds on intent-header-source-check.sh from draft-2; the per-language patterns extend that script's parse step."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["e2e0-90c3-887b-4708"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-6"},{"id":"cdcc-f79f-049b-45c9","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want a nine-scenario multi-language synthetic end-to-end test, so that the full checks-to-verifier path is proven across happy-path and adversarial fixtures.","description":"## Description
**What**: Build a multi-language synthetic end-to-end test exercising the nine fixture scenarios from SC5 end to end (both scripts plus the completion-verifier consumption).
**Why**: The unit tests cover each script in isolation; this story proves the integrated path including the verifier rendering, and pins the primary real-world miss pattern (mid-sprint SC addition) as a regression fixture.
**Scope**:
- IN: fixtures and assertions for (a) happy path Python plus bash (zero findings), (b) intent_with_no_test with a non-empty verifier 'Intent Allocation Findings' section, (c) header_source_mismatch for a Python and a bash fixture, (d) source_files_unresolved fail-open skip, (e) file_impact_likely_stale with surviving-entry matching, (f) deferred_test override not blocking closure, (g) missing_sg emitting dynamic_import_inconclusive with no grep fallback and no pre-commit block, (h) backward_compat_94ed_legacy graceful handling; the mid-sprint-SC-addition scenario run in a configuration-isolated environment.
- OUT: per-language dynamic-import pattern detection unit verification (sc-6, covered by draft-5); the scripts and wiring themselves.","priority":3,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["The e2e test exercises the happy-path Python and bash fixtures end to end and both scripts return zero findings ← Satisfies: sc-5","The e2e test exercises the intent_with_no_test, header_source_mismatch, source_files_unresolved, file_impact_likely_stale, deferred_test-override, missing_sg, and backward_compat_94ed_legacy fixtures and each produces its specified finding and severity ← Satisfies: sc-5","An integration test exercises the mid-sprint-SC-addition path (1 SC and 1 passing test_artifact, then a 2nd SC added with no test_artifact) in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no environment variables pre-set from the developer's machine) and the test passes, surfacing intent_with_no_test and a non-empty 'Intent Allocation Findings' section ← Validates Closure Check: "(i) MID_SPRINT_SC_ADDITION: fixture epic with 1 SC and 1 test_artifact registered passing; a 2nd SC is added to the epic description without registering a corresponding test_artifact. intent-coverage-check.sh surfaces intent_with_no_test for the new SC; completion-verifier dispatch produces non-empty 'Intent Allocation Findings' section. Verifies the primary real-world miss pattern.""],"considerations":["[Build] The e2e test script is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.","[Reliability] The mid-sprint-SC-addition fixture must isolate HOME and git config so it does not inherit the developer machine's ambient git identity or worktrees, which would mask CI-only failures.","[Performance] The e2e suite runs the test-pass validation step; keep individual fixture invocations targeted so the suite stays within the bash-tool timeout when run via test-batched.sh."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["bca2-b2e4-92a2-4b99","e2e0-90c3-887b-4708","fa72-1ea7-755c-401a"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-5"}],"storyDashboard":{"totalStories":5,"uiStories":0,"criticalPath":["bca2-b2e4-92a2-4b99","e2e0-90c3-887b-4708","fa72-1ea7-755c-401a"]}}
